summary: Attach an Examples block to the generated `feedback` command through the novel-command hook instead of editing the generated file.
reason: The generated internal/cli/feedback.go ships with no Example, so live dogfood's help-quality probe fails it with 'missing Examples section'. Editing feedback.go directly would be reverted by `generate --force`, so the examples are added from the hand-authored internal/cli/rundown_framework_help.go via registerNovelCommand, which regeneration preserves. The hook defers if a future generator version supplies its own examples.
validated_outcome: `rundown-pp-cli feedback --help` renders four examples; live dogfood full matrix went from 3 failures to 0 (106/106).
